articles.title: Polish lawmakers back revised crypto bill after repeated vetoes
articles.snippet: Polish lawmakers approve a Ministry of Finance-backed crypto bill to implement the EU MiCA framework in a 241–200 vote after repeated vetoes.

articles.title: UK politician Nigel Farage bought $1.8M house after $6.7M crypto gift
articles.snippet: The news follows growing calls from UK lawmakers and government officials to curb or temporarily ban crypto political donations in the country.
